evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Identified content (color/coordinate sets), explicit origin/organization metadata, and separate status/attribute lines are present for the same referents/times.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal substrings identify represented contents (color-labeled coordinate sets) and attributes.

D.rationale: Content (color/positions) is listed separately from origin/organization metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization metadata describe how contents are presented/emerge (copied_prior_record, inherited_current, history_estimate, command_estimate).
